component.name: Nautilus Markdown Viewer
component.summary: Preview and edit Markdown alongside your files

description.p: Read Markdown in a resizable GNOME Files side pane or a standalone GTK window. Preview tables, images, task lists, highlighted code, and equations.
Edit documents with syntax highlighting, save changes in place, and follow updates from external editors. The standalone window includes search, a table of contents, zoom, and light and dark themes.
The Nautilus side pane depends on the host file manager. Equations and remote images require a network connection.
Faster rich previews, loading feedback, safer saves, and desktop integration fixes.
